purpose: Govern the production fallback from BLS-hosted routes blocked by HTTP 403 to official Department of Labor hosted post-release copies of BLS Employment Situation and CPI releases.

sources.available_at_policy: published_at is the BLS embargo/publication timestamp printed inside the mirrored BLS release PDF and interpreted in America/New_York. Because the exact DOL mirror posting time is not proven, available_at is the first successful live acquisition time of the exact DOL PDF and must never precede published_at. Filename date and scheduled calendar time never prove availability.
